name: Che pibe catering
address: 1218 S Dixie Hwy, Hollywood, FL 33020, United States

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Mariela Torres Zuniga
reviewSamples.text: Che Pibe’s empanadas deserve a special mention—they are, without a doubt, the BEST in the entire Miami-Fort Lauderdale area. The flavors are rich, the pastry is perfectly flaky, and each bite is a delight that transport your taste buds to Argentina. These empanadas are a hidden gem that you simply cannot miss. Gracias Che Pibe!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Gretel Tellez
reviewSamples.text: Delicious diches. Their empanadas are amazing. My favorite is the ham and cheese. The place is impeccable clean, and their customer service is exceptional, very affordable prices.
